front_entry.name: Front Entry
front_entry.description: A glass-fronted genkan in a modern Higashi-Gotanda house. Shoes line the recessed rack; the doorway opens onto the shared living floor, with the kitchen and dining table in view. Stairs lead to the bedrooms and rooftop, and the garage opens beside the entry.

living_room.name: Living Room
living_room.description: Floor-to-ceiling glass brings Tokyo daylight across a broad sofa and low coffee table. The open-plan room connects to the kitchen and dining area; stairs link the bedrooms and rooftop.

kitchen.name: Open Kitchen
kitchen.description: An island counter, full-size refrigerator and rice cooker anchor the open kitchen. Grocery notes and a washing-up rota share a board beside the counter.

dining_room.name: Dining Room
dining_room.description: A long communal table sits between the kitchen and the glass wall. Seven chairs make room for the six original housemates and the new arrival.

boys_bedroom.name: Boys' Bedroom
boys_bedroom.description: The shared bedroom for Makoto, Yuki and Uchi has three beds, individual storage and a small common sitting area. Knock and wait for an invitation before entering.

girls_bedroom.name: Girls' Bedroom
girls_bedroom.description: The shared bedroom for Minori, Mizuki and Yuriko has three beds, individual storage and a shared dressing area. Knock and wait for an invitation before entering.

player_bedroom.name: Your Guest Room
player_bedroom.description: A small furnished guest room reserved for you, the seventh resident, with a single bed, desk and suitcase space. This extra room belongs to the game adaptation of the house.

shared_bathroom.name: Shared Bathroom
shared_bathroom.description: A shared washroom with separate bathing space, towels and labeled toiletry baskets. The occupied sign and a closed door mean wait outside.

terrace.name: Rooftop Terrace
terrace.description: A furnished rooftop terrace above the glass-fronted house, with outdoor seating and a view across residential Higashi-Gotanda toward the Tokyo skyline.

garage.name: Garage
garage.description: Two shared cars sit beneath the house. A key board and a simple booking notebook help residents coordinate commutes, shopping trips and days out.

neighborhood.name: Higashi-Gotanda Streets
neighborhood.description: Quiet residential streets in Shinagawa Ward connect the house with small restaurants, shops and the busier streets around Gotanda Station.

gotanda_station.name: Gotanda Station
gotanda_station.description: The station connects the neighborhood to the JR Yamanote Line and the wider city. Ticket gates, platform signs and a meeting spot outside make it a useful starting point for a day out.

cafe.name: Neighborhood Cafe
cafe.description: A small neighborhood cafe with a coffee counter and window seats. It is a game-created local place for a drink, a work break or an unhurried conversation.

dance_studio.name: Tap Dance Studio
dance_studio.description: A rented Tokyo rehearsal studio with a sprung wooden floor, mirrors and stacked folding chairs. This game-created workplace is reached by a short train ride and walk from Gotanda.

salon.name: Hair Salon
salon.description: A bright Tokyo salon with mirrored stations, appointment books and a waiting bench. This game-created workplace is reached by a short train ride and walk from Gotanda.
